en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Dyad on Roots to be Abandoned by Cultivation (Bhāvanāyapahātabbahetukaduka)

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and has roots to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state that is not non-demonstrable, not non-reactive, and does not have roots to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are six under root, three under object ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state that is neither demonstrable nor reactive, whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are three [answers] for the root [condition] … pe … three for the non-disappearance [condition].
